note: Sources for How life works. Every step cites one or more of these ids. Each page was read on the date given before it was cited. Step text is original wording, not copied.

sources.title: Biology 2e, 4.3 Eukaryotic Cells
sources.section: The nucleus, nuclear envelope and pores; ribosomes; mitochondria; chloroplasts

sources.title: Biology 2e, 5.2 Passive Transport
sources.section: Diffusion, dynamic equilibrium, osmosis, aquaporins, tonicity (hypotonic, isotonic, hypertonic) and red blood cells

sources.title: Biology 2e, 7.2 Glycolysis
sources.section: Glycolysis in the cytoplasm: glucose to two pyruvate, 2 ATP spent, 4 made, net 2 ATP and 2 NADH

sources.title: Biology 2e, 7.3 Oxidation of Pyruvate and the Citric Acid Cycle
sources.section: Pyruvate to acetyl CoA in the matrix; per turn 2 CO2, 3 NADH, 1 FADH2, 1 GTP or ATP

sources.title: Biology 2e, 7.4 Oxidative Phosphorylation
sources.section: Electron transport chain, oxygen as final electron acceptor, chemiosmosis, ATP synthase; ATP yield varies

sources.title: Biology 2e, 8.1 Overview of Photosynthesis
sources.section: Chloroplast structure (thylakoids, grana, stroma); the two stages linked by ATP, NADPH, ADP and NADP+

sources.title: Biology 2e, 8.2 The Light-Dependent Reactions of Photosynthesis
sources.section: Photosystems II and I, water splitting, electron transport, H+ gradient into the lumen, ATP synthase, NADPH

sources.title: Biology 2e, 8.3 Using Light Energy to Make Organic Molecules
sources.section: Calvin cycle in the stroma: fixation by RuBisCO, reduction, regeneration; three turns per exported G3P, six per glucose

sources.title: Biology 2e, 10.2 The Cell Cycle
sources.section: Interphase and the stages of mitosis (prophase, prometaphase, metaphase, anaphase, telophase) and cytokinesis

sources.title: Biology 2e, 15.1 The Genetic Code
sources.section: Codons, 64 triplets, 61 code for amino acids, 3 stop codons, AUG start; Figure 15.4 genetic code table

sources.title: Biology 2e, 15.3 Eukaryotic Transcription
sources.section: RNA polymerase II in the nucleus, promoters, 5' to 3' synthesis, mRNA must reach the cytoplasm

sources.title: Biology 2e, 15.4 RNA Processing in Eukaryotes
sources.section: 5' cap, poly-A tail of about 200 adenines, splicing of introns, export through nuclear pores

sources.title: Biology 2e, 15.5 Ribosomes and Protein Synthesis
sources.section: Ribosome subunits, tRNA anticodons, A, P and E sites, initiation at AUG, elongation, termination with release factors at UAA, UAG, UGA

sources.title: Yang et al. (2020), The Light Dependence of Mesophyll Conductance and Relative Limitations on Photosynthesis in Evergreen Sclerophyllous Rhododendron Species
sources.section: Measured light response: net photosynthesis was saturated or almost saturated at 800 micromoles of photons per square metre per second
sources.publisher: Plants (Basel), open access via PubMed Central PMC7697185
